Drama.dc.html.title: Dramatic motion and graphics, press Play

n-drama.text: Press Play, then press each button. These moments are for actions only: an update finished, something failed, a row deleted. The arriving scene and the empty picture on this board are NOT to be built on resting pages.

n-keep.text: Nothing is removed. Every tool, filter, column, menu entry and setting that exists today stays reachable in the same number of presses or fewer. Tools that leave a toolbar row move into a pill or its More tools menu. Whoever builds a page lists every control on the page before and after, and a control missing afterwards fails the job.

n-owner3.text: Owner decisions, 20 November 2026. 1: the interface stays close to how it looks today, with a modern polish. 2: dramatic animations and graphics are for ACTIONS only (finished, failed, deleted, saved); pages get transitions only. 3: nothing is removed. 4: dashboard cards stay as they are.

n-pills.text: Press Play and move the pointer. Floating pills for page tools on a desktop: an item widens to show its name on hover or keyboard focus, and Filter opens its menu on hover. Built in the polish pass; to be checked in a browser.

n-main.text: Automations list. Today's page, polished: same title bar, tabs, summary line, filter chips, group header and rows. Polish: names wrap to two lines, 48 px targets, the tab row fades where it scrolls, and Sort, Group and More sit in one small floating pill beside Create so nothing covers a row. Try Tweaks: accent, motion. Unbuilt: nothing new here; this is the look to hold.

n-apphome.text: Front door. Today's page, polished: same greeting, scene pills, amber needs-you block, Summaries and three-across Areas. Polish: the summary line carries real facts, text wraps, even spacing, cards rise once on entry. Unbuilt: nothing new here.

n-appentity.text: Entity sheet. Today's sheet, polished: same header, icons, slider, mode row, favourite colours and tabs. Polish: the name wraps to two lines, the icon tile cross-fades with the state, the slider eases. Unbuilt: nothing new here.

n-appeditor.text: Automation editor. Today's editor, polished: same Simple, Advanced, YAML switch, numbered When, And if, Then do cards, and the Run now, Check, Dry run, Save bar. Polish: each step says its live state in plain words, even spacing, 48 px targets. Unbuilt: the live state line on steps.

n-appupdates.text: Updates. Today's page, polished: same ready card, Update coming soon row, Automatic updates card and update rows. Polish: Check now sits inside the ready card, Update everything is the one main button, the automatic card says its state in plain words, long names wrap. No confirmation changes. Unbuilt: the button placement.

n-quicksearch.text: Quick controls wherever a thing is listed: a switch gets its toggle, a dimmer gets a slider, a colour light gets a colour button, a sensor shows its value. A lock, alarm, door or cover shows its button but asks first with the app's own confirmation. Every row also has Run a quick action and Show more details. Shown here in search results; the same row is used in entity lists, device pages, area pages and pickers. Unbuilt: all of it.

n-quickaction.text: Run a quick action. Guided tab: pick an action this thing really supports, set its values with real controls, add a wait or more steps. YAML tab: write or paste the same thing as text. Run plays it once and throws it away; Keep as a script saves it. Risky actions ask first. Nothing is saved unless asked. Unbuilt: all of it.

n-moredetails.text: Show more details, on every thing, in place: entity ID with copy, device, integration, raw state, last changed, every attribute. A pencil sets a state or attribute by hand, after a confirmation, with a plain warning that the device is not told. No trip to the developer tools needed, and a link goes there for the rest. Unbuilt: all of it.

n-site.text: The project site, in its own look, polished. 1: the welcome no longer covers the headline; it is a slim band that can be dismissed. 2: the old badge that said the interface was only begun becomes a live line with the newest build and date, filled from the release data, linking to the changes. 3: the hero picture is a real capture of the newest build. 4: a short What is new row, filled from the change list, never by hand. 5: buttons press and hover, sections rise once. Resize the board: everything wraps down to a phone. Unbuilt: all five.
